fullText.simplified:
二、一个女鬼

    钟小果在地铁里，她要回家。
    一个女鬼在看钟小果，但是钟小果不认识她。钟小果想：“她是谁？她为什么看我？她知道我能看见她吗？”
    钟小果不看女鬼，她不希望女鬼知道她能看见鬼。女鬼来到钟小果的身边，钟小果还是不看女鬼。突然，女鬼来到钟小果的前面，钟小果往后走了走。
    地铁里有很多人，钟小果看看时间，八点了，她要下车了。这时候，女鬼不见了，女鬼走了。
    星期五，钟小果在学校，她和同学们在学习。她往后看，一个女鬼在她后面。是她，昨天地铁里的那个鬼。
    钟小果学习的时候，女鬼在她的后面。钟小果买东西的时候，女鬼在她的后面。钟小果吃饭的时候，女鬼还在她的后面。女鬼不说话，女鬼看着她。
    晚上七点五十分，钟小果一个人回家。
    女鬼来了，她说：“你好！”
    钟小果没说话，她往前走。
fullText.traditional:
二、一個女鬼

    鍾小果在地鐵裡，她要回家。
    一個女鬼在看鍾小果，但是鍾小果不認識她。鍾小果想：“她是誰？她為什麼看我？她知道我能看見她嗎？”
    鍾小果不看女鬼，她不希望女鬼知道她能看見鬼。女鬼來到鍾小果的身邊，鍾小果還是不看女鬼。突然，女鬼來到鍾小果的前面，鍾小果往後走了走。
    地鐵裡有很多人，鍾小果看看時間，八點了，她要下車了。這時候，女鬼不見了，女鬼走了。
    星期五，鍾小果在學校，她和同學們在學習。她往後看，一個女鬼在她後面。是她，昨天地鐵裡的那個鬼。
    鍾小果學習的時候，女鬼在她的後面。鍾小果買東西的時候，女鬼在她的後面。鍾小果吃飯的時候，女鬼還在她的後面。女鬼不說話，女鬼看著她。
    晚上七點五十分，鍾小果一個人回家。
    女鬼來了，她說：“你好！”
    鍾小果沒說話，她往前走。

sentences.simplified: 钟小果在地铁里，她要回家。
sentences.traditional: 鍾小果在地鐵裡，她要回家。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng xiǎo guǒ zài dì tiě lǐ tā yào huí jiā
sentences.english: Zhong Xiaoguo was in the subway. She was going home.

sentences.simplified: 一个女鬼在看钟小果，但是钟小果不认识她。
sentences.traditional: 一個女鬼在看鍾小果，但是鍾小果不認識她。
sentences.pinyin: yí ge nǚ guǐ zài kàn zhōng xiǎo guǒ dàn shì zhōng xiǎo guǒ bú rèn shi tā
sentences.english: A female ghost was watching Zhong Xiaoguo, but Zhong Xiaoguo didn’t recognize her.

sentences.simplified: 钟小果想：“她是谁？她为什么看我？她知道我能看见她吗？”
sentences.traditional: 鍾小果想：“她是誰？她為什麼看我？她知道我能看見她嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: zhōng xiǎo guǒ xiǎng tā shì shéi tā wèi shén me kàn wǒ tā zhī dào wǒ néng kàn jiàn tā ma
sentences.english: Zhong Xiaoguo wondered, “Who is she? Why is she looking at me? Does she know I can see her?”

sentences.simplified: 钟小果不看女鬼，她不希望女鬼知道她能看见鬼。
sentences.traditional: 鍾小果不看女鬼，她不希望女鬼知道她能看見鬼。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng xiǎo guǒ bú kàn nǚ guǐ tā bù xī wàng nǚ guǐ zhī dào tā néng kàn jiàn guǐ
sentences.english: Zhong Xiaoguo didn’t look at the female ghost. She didn’t want the female ghost to know that she can see ghosts.

sentences.simplified: 女鬼来到钟小果的身边，钟小果还是不看女鬼。
sentences.traditional: 女鬼來到鍾小果的身邊，鍾小果還是不看女鬼。
sentences.pinyin: nǚ guǐ lái dào zhōng xiǎo guǒ de shēn biān zhōng xiǎo guǒ hái shi bú kàn nǚ guǐ
sentences.english: The female ghost came to Zhong Xiaoguo’s side, but Zhong Xiaoguo still didn’t look at the female ghost.

sentences.simplified: 突然，女鬼来到钟小果的前面，钟小果往后走了走。
sentences.traditional: 突然，女鬼來到鍾小果的前面，鍾小果往後走了走。
sentences.pinyin: tū rán nǚ guǐ lái dào zhōng xiǎo guǒ de qián miàn zhōng xiǎo guǒ wǎng hòu zǒu le zǒu
sentences.english: Suddenly, the female ghost came in front of Zhong Xiaoguo. Zhong Xiaoguo turned back and walked away.

sentences.simplified: 地铁里有很多人，钟小果看看时间，八点了，她要下车了。
sentences.traditional: 地鐵裡有很多人，鍾小果看看時間，八點了，她要下車了。
sentences.pinyin: dì tiě lǐ yǒu hěn duō rén zhōng xiǎo guǒ kàn kan shí jiān bā diǎn le tā yào xià chē le
sentences.english: There were many people in the subway. Zhong Xiaoguo looked at the time. It was eight o’clock. She needed to get off.

sentences.simplified: 这时候，女鬼不见了，女鬼走了。
sentences.traditional: 這時候，女鬼不見了，女鬼走了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí hou nǚ guǐ bú jiàn le nǚ guǐ zǒu le
sentences.english: At this moment, the female ghost disappeared. The female ghost had left.

sentences.simplified: 星期五，钟小果在学校，她和同学们在学习。
sentences.traditional: 星期五，鍾小果在學校，她和同學們在學習。
sentences.pinyin: xīng qī wǔ zhōng xiǎo guǒ zài xué xiào tā hé tóng xué men zài xué xí
sentences.english: On Friday, Zhong Xiaoguo was at school. She and her classmates were studying.

sentences.simplified: 她往后看，一个女鬼在她后面。是她，昨天地铁里的那个鬼。

sentences.traditional: 鍾小果學習的時候，女鬼在她的後面。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng xiǎo guǒ xué xí de shí hou nǚ guǐ zài tā de hòu miàn
sentences.english: When Zhong Xiaoguo was studying, the female ghost was behind her.

sentences.simplified: 钟小果买东西的时候，女鬼在她的后面。
sentences.traditional: 鍾小果買東西的時候，女鬼在她的後面。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng xiǎo guǒ mǎi dōng xi de shí hou nǚ guǐ zài tā de hòu miàn
sentences.english: When Zhong Xiaoguo was shopping, the female ghost was behind her.

sentences.simplified: 钟小果吃饭的时候，女鬼还在她的后面。
sentences.traditional: 鍾小果吃飯的時候，女鬼還在她的後面。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng xiǎo guǒ chī fàn de shí hou nǚ guǐ hái zài tā de hòu miàn
sentences.english: When Zhong Xiaoguo was eating, the female ghost was still behind her.

sentences.simplified: 女鬼不说话，女鬼看着她。
sentences.traditional: 女鬼不說話，女鬼看著她。
sentences.pinyin: nǚ guǐ bù shuō huà nǚ guǐ kàn zhe tā

sentences.simplified: 晚上七点五十分，钟小果一个人回家。
sentences.traditional: 晚上七點五十分，鍾小果一個人回家。

sentences.english: At 7:50 in the evening, Zhong Xiaoguo went home alone.

sentences.simplified: 女鬼来了，她说：“你好！”
sentences.traditional: 女鬼來了，她說：“你好！”

sentences.pinyin: zhōng xiǎo guǒ méi shuō huà tā wǎng qián zǒu
sentences.english: Zhong Xiaoguo didn’t speak. She walked forward.

sentence_translations: Zhong Xiaoguo was in the subway. She was going home.
A female ghost was watching Zhong Xiaoguo, but Zhong Xiaoguo didn’t recognize her.
Zhong Xiaoguo wondered, “Who is she? Why is she looking at me? Does she know I can see her?”
Zhong Xiaoguo didn’t look at the female ghost. She didn’t want the female ghost to know that she can see ghosts.
The female ghost came to Zhong Xiaoguo’s side, but Zhong Xiaoguo still didn’t look at the female ghost.
Suddenly, the female ghost came in front of Zhong Xiaoguo. Zhong Xiaoguo turned back and walked away.
There were many people in the subway. Zhong Xiaoguo looked at the time. It was eight o’clock. She needed to get off.
At this moment, the female ghost disappeared. The female ghost had left.
On Friday, Zhong Xiaoguo was at school. She and her classmates were studying.
She turned back and looked. A female ghost was behind her. It was her, the ghost from inside the subway yesterday.
When Zhong Xiaoguo was studying, the female ghost was behind her.
When Zhong Xiaoguo was shopping, the female ghost was behind her.
When Zhong Xiaoguo was eating, the female ghost was still behind her.
The female ghost didn’t speak. The female ghost watched her.
At 7:50 in the evening, Zhong Xiaoguo went home alone.
The female ghost arrived. She said, “Hello!”
Zhong Xiaoguo didn’t speak. She walked forward.
